## About
Pacman Plumbing, LLC is a plumbing company based on W Lane Ave in Phoenix. We track down leaks, work on gas water heaters, and can move a water heater out of the laundry room to make more space inside.
We keep the same hours every day of the week, so a plumbing problem on a Sunday doesn't have to wait until Monday. You can call us or book an appointment through our website.

## Services
- Water leaks: When water is leaking inside the house or through a wall, we find where it's coming from and fix it.
- Gas water heater service: Work on gas water heaters, done neatly and professionally.
- Water heater install: Taking a water heater out of a laundry room and installing it on the outside of the home to create more space.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. We're open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on Sunday, the same hours as the rest of the week.

Q: Do you work on gas water heaters?
A: Yes. One customer reviewed our work on their gas water heater and said everything looked very professional.
